title: Mine Piece HUD - One Piece Addon
description: An RPG-style interface for Mine Piece that organizes stats, skills, Haki, crews, and shortcuts. Compatible with HakMinePiece, UltimateMinePiece, and One Piece World Like, with support for English, Portuguese, Spanish, and Japanese.
body:
This addon enhances the Mine Piece experience with an RPG-inspired interface that brings important character information and features together in one convenient menu.

Track your stats, experience, currency, active effects, and character progression. Browse your powers, organize skills in a customizable hotbar, and easily switch between the standard Minecraft hotbar and your combat skill hotbar.

The menu also integrates Haki, crew, and interface settings, making your adventure more organized and accessible. Skills can display their energy cost, casting time, and cooldown, helping you prepare for every battle.

Compatible with:

- Mine Piece
- HakMinePiece
- UltimateMinePiece
- One Piece World Like

All integrations are optional. The addon will continue to work even when some compatible addons are not installed.

Available languages:

- English
- Portuguese
- Spanish
- Japanese

The interface automatically follows the player’s Minecraft language. It can also be changed directly from the menu, with English used as the fallback for unsupported languages.

A great choice for players who want a cleaner, more immersive, and RPG-inspired way to enjoy Mine Piece while keeping the familiar visual style of Minecraft.
